# Gemini AI Tech Company

This repository contains the full configuration for an autonomous AI Software Company powered by Gemini CLI. It includes specialized agents, expert skills, and the "Global CEO Directive" that enables autonomous orchestration.

## Features
- **Global CEO Directive**: Enables the 13-step autonomous lifecycle.
- **Specialized Agents**: 17+ core and innovation agents (Frontend, Backend, QA, Psychology, etc.).
- **Expert Skills**: Specialized mental models for deep technical tasks.
- **Company Memory**: Persistent knowledge and history tracking.

---

## Setup Instructions

### 1. Prerequisites
Ensure you have the Gemini CLI installed on your machine.

### 2. Clone the Repository
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Anshgrag/gemini-ai-team.git
cd gemini-ai-team
```

### 3. Deploy Configuration

#### **For macOS / Linux (Bash/Zsh)**
Run the following commands to copy the configuration to your Gemini home directory:

```bash
# Create directories if they don't exist
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/agents ~/.gemini/skills ~/.gemini/templates ~/.gemini/company_memory

# Copy the files
cp GEMINI.md ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md
cp -r agents/* ~/.gemini/agents/
cp -r skills/* ~/.gemini/skills/
cp -r templates/* ~/.gemini/templates/
cp -r company_memory/* ~/.gemini/company_memory/
```

#### **For Windows (PowerShell)**
Run the following commands in PowerShell:

```powershell
# Create directories if they don't exist
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$HOME\.gemini\agents", "$HOME\.gemini\skills", "$HOME\.gemini\templates", "$HOME\.gemini\company_memory"

# Copy the files
Copy-Item -Path "GEMINI.md" -Destination "$HOME\.gemini\GEMINI.md" -Force
Copy-Item -Path "agents\*" -Destination "$HOME\.gemini\agents\" -Recurse -Force
Copy-Item -Path "skills\*" -Destination "$HOME\.gemini\skills\" -Recurse -Force
Copy-Item -Path "templates\*" -Destination "$HOME\.gemini\templates\" -Recurse -Force
Copy-Item -Path "company_memory\*" -Destination "$HOME\.gemini\company_memory\" -Recurse -Force
```

### 4. Verification
Start a new Gemini session and ask:
`"Who are you?"`
If correctly set up, Gemini should identify as the **CEO of an autonomous AI Software Company**.
